holder-quote: It cut off his hand. A lasso of metal tightened, and Mectail stared at a bloody stump. Yvlon’s arm began to retract as she ran at him, her other arm raised, turning into a longsword’s blade. She slashed. Mectail looked at her, eyes wide with sudden pain and fury.
effect-quote: Yvlon bounced off the magical dome and hit the ground below. Ribs well and painfully broken.
